notes: Draft configuration: The lake circuit follows the complete independently named Avenida Circuito del Lago, including its southern bends and the bridge section. Argentina tourism identifies this public-road circuit and access avenue; government documentation describes the 6.270 km historical course. The actual pinned road loop is 6172.4 m and remains unadjusted. Race-day barriers, chicane alignment and travel direction remain provisional; unrelated residential and service-road detours are excluded. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 6172.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
